name: MANAS DHAMNE
bio:
Career Overview: Playing Style: An aggressive baseliner with a strong forehand and improving serve, showing versatility in singles and potential in doubles.
Best Grand Slam Singles Performance: Yet to play in a senior Grand Slam main draw; reached the second round of the 2023 Australian Open Juniors.
Notable Achievements: ITF Titles: Won his maiden ITF singles title at the 2025 M15 Monastir as a qualifier, defeating Lorenzo Carboni (2-6, 6-0, 6-1), becoming the second-youngest Indian male to win a pro title at 17 years, 1 month. Biggest Singles Win: Upset World No. 378 Nicholas David Ionel (4-6, 7-6(5), 7-5) at the 2024 ITF M15 Targu Jiu. Junior Success: Youngest Indian to win the ITF Asian B1 Junior Championship (2022) and the first player born in 2007 to compete in an ATP main draw (2023 Tata Open Maharashtra). Davis Cup & National Representation: Yet to debut in Davis Cup but considered a future prospect.
Other Highlights: Trained at the Piatti Tennis Center in Italy under Riccardo Piatti (coach of Jannik Sinner). Made his ATP debut at 15 via wildcard at the 2023 Tata Open Maharashtra (lost to Michael Mmoh). Received over ₹15 lakh in scholarships from MSLTA in March 2025.
Manas is a rising star in Indian tennis, eyed as a potential torchbearer for the next generation. 🎾🇮🇳 🎾🇮🇳
